literal_meaning: বলদ বা ষাঁড়ের শিং (stubbornness associated with a bull's horn)
figurative_meaning_en: Excessive stubbornness; rigid or one-track temperament
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার ষাঁড়ের গোঁ এতটাই যে কোনো কথাই শোনে না।
এই ষাঁড়ের গোঁয়ের কারণে সবাই তার সঙ্গে কাজ করতে চায় না।
example_sentences_in_english: His bull-like stubbornness is so intense that he doesn't listen to anyone.
Because of his rigid temperament, no one wants to work with him.
history: This idiom draws from the common observation in rural Bengal of bulls being notoriously stubborn animals, often used in farming and plowing, symbolizing unyielding nature.
note: The idiom reflects traditional agrarian life in Bengal where bulls are integral to daily work.
